category: Voice AI platform for Indian languages

markLogic.encoding: The waveform IS the product — every bar is a voice call being handled. The varying heights show natural conversation cadence.
markLogic.diagramReading: If the mark were a diagram of the product, it would be a live audio stream: calls coming in, AI responding, conversations flowing naturally in every language.

invertedClaim: Unlike chatbots that text, Bolna puts AI on the phone — in your customer's own language, with the speed and nuance of a human.

tension.says: Voice AI built for India — go live in minutes.
tension.shows: Production-grade telephony stack: 10+ vernacular languages, <300ms latency, 250+ concurrent calls, enterprise data residency, 20+ model integrations, full API control.

visualRules.rule: Dark navy canvas as the ground; the product lives in darkness like a phone call at night.
Waveform motif in structure — audio bars pulse, ripple, assemble. Never decorative squiggles.
Teal accent carries every 'active/live' moment — a call connecting, an agent responding, a stat counting.
Vernacular text is infrastructure, not novelty — show Hindi/Tamil/Telugu as naturally as English.
Proof beats claims: show the agent card, the API call, the latency number. Never a static benefit sentence.
Sound-first energy: the video should feel like listening to a conversation, not reading a slideshow.

motionInference.entryDirection: elements emerge from center outward (like sound radiating from a source)

failureModes.mode: Generic chatbot/AI slideshow (purple gradients, robot emoji)
failureModes.whyItRuins: Bolna is voice, not chat. Phone calls, not text bubbles.
Vernacular is the core infrastructure play, not a gimmick.
Half the audience is developers. The Python/JS snippets are a differentiator.
Bolna replaces call centers. Showing headsets = the old world.

failureModes.mode: Static benefit cards with no motion
failureModes.whyItRuins: A voice company's video must feel alive — waveforms, pulses, response animations.
